entries.need: Read repository, issue, pull request and Project state from the tracker the team already uses.
entries.condition: The repository is hosted on GitHub and the team already operates issues or Projects there.

license.note: The server is MIT. The GitHub service it reaches stays under its own plan and terms.

cost.note: The server adds no license cost. Usage is bounded by the account's existing GitHub plan.

scopes: Start read-only; read:project before any write scope
Grant write scopes one operation at a time
auth.note: Token is directed at this server and never passed through to another service.

data: Repository, issue and pull request content the token can read

permissions.note: Reaches the GitHub API only; it does not read or write the working tree.

maintenance.note: Released under the github organisation; latest tag published 2026-08-25.

entries.rollback: Remove the server configuration, revoke the token and delete or reconcile any item the receipt attributes to it.

entries.need: Read current official documentation for a library or API whose surface changes faster than training data.
entries.condition: The project depends on libraries or APIs that move quickly and the team hits stale-documentation errors.

license.note: The published package is MIT. The hosted service behind it keeps its own terms and plan.

cost.note: The package costs nothing. The hosted lookup service is bounded by the provider plan chosen at activation.

scopes: An API key raises rate limits and is optional for basic lookups
auth.note: Activation without a key is possible; the key stays an environment reference and never enters this catalogue.

data: Library or package name and version

permissions.note: Sends a query and receives documentation text; it does not read the working tree.

maintenance.note: Published on the npm registry by the upstash organisation.

entries.rollback: Remove the server or skill configuration and revoke the API key if one was issued.

entries.need: Verify a browser flow with a versioned, repeatable test rather than an interactive exploration.
entries.condition: The product exposes a web UI or a browser-driven flow that has to stay verifiable in CI.

license.note: Apache-2.0 for the runner and the browser drivers it installs.

cost.note: No license or service cost. Browser downloads and CI minutes are the real consumption.

auth.note: The runner needs no account. Only the application under test may require credentials, which stay outside this catalogue.

data: URLs, DOM snapshots, screenshots and traces of the application under test
Any test credential the project chooses to supply at run time

permissions.note: Writes test artifacts and downloads browser binaries during installation.

maintenance.note: Released frequently on the npm registry by the Playwright team.

entries.rollback: Remove the package, the configuration and the downloaded browser artifacts, and revert the generated tests.

entries.need: Map architecture, call paths, dependencies and change impact in a repository too large to read directly.
entries.stateReason: No provider is selected yet. License, cost and authentication depend on the implementation chosen, so the entry cannot resolve as universal or conditional until a candidate is evaluated.

license.note: Depends entirely on the provider selected; local and hosted implementations differ.

cost.note: A local index may cost nothing while a hosted service may be metered or plan-bound.

auth.note: Local implementations need no account; some hosted services do. Unknown until a candidate is named.

data: Depends on the provider: a local index, or source uploaded to a hosted service

permissions.note: Recorded as the minimum a local implementation would need; a hosted candidate would raise this.

maintenance.note: Not applicable until a specific provider is evaluated.

entries.rollback: Delete the index and its configuration and return to local search.
